data.title: HDT-15: API Enhancements for Search/Filter (HDT-16 dependency)

data.body:
✓ Review Complete

Implementation verified against plan:

**Functionality:**
- SearchFilter imported and added to filter_backends ✓
- search_fields = ['dev_eui'] enables ?search=device1 substring search ✓
- Status filter added to get_queryset() for ?status=passing|failing|unknown ✓
- 'latest_status' added to ordering_fields for ?ordering=latest_status ✓

**Code Quality:**
- Follows existing code patterns (minimal, focused changes)
- Integrates cleanly with existing failure_type filter
- No regressions to existing API behavior
- All acceptance criteria met

**Testing:**
The API changes enable the following query patterns:
- GET /api/payloads/devices/?search=device1 (text search)
- GET /api/payloads/devices/?status=failing (status filter)
- GET /api/payloads/devices/?ordering=-latest_status (sort by status desc)
- GET /api/payloads/devices/?search=dev&status=failing&ordering=-updated_at (combined)

These changes are ready for HDT-16 (Device Search/Filter UI) to consume.

Status: PASS — All acceptance criteria met, no issues found.
